name: OT/ICS Firmware Findings Import
description: Receives firmware vulnerability research findings via webhook. Creates one MISP event per firmware image, adds a software object, adds one vulnerability object per finding (standard fields + ICS scoring fields stored with force=1), adds file and port attributes, and triggers CVE enrichment via the MISP cve module. Review events in MISP, then trigger OT/ICS Firmware Triage.
